heroSub: In the project implemented at Borgwarner's factory in Izmir ESBAS Free Zone, individual laser marking and traceability of each produced product were aimed.
contextTitle: Individual traceability in the automotive supply industry
contextP1: Borgwarner's factory in Izmir ESBAS Free Zone produces for the automotive supply industry. In the project implemented at this factory, individual laser marking and traceability of each produced product were aimed.
contextP2: Automatic execution of marking accuracy and database integration is of great importance for maintaining quality processes.
problemTitle: Separate steps and traceability gap risk
problemLede: Each produced part had to be marked with a unique serial number, ensuring marking accuracy and transmitting the traceability data to the central system. Marking and verification progressing as separate, uncoupled steps carried the risk of incorrect or unreadable codes and gaps in traceability.

problemList.text: Inability to instantly detect unreadable or incorrect code printing caused by laser power or surface roughness.
Loss of labor and time resulting from separate execution of marking and camera verification steps.

solutionLede: A laser marking machine supporting marking and identification processes was developed for Borgwarner. The machine was designed with 3-axis motion capability to adapt to different products. The system was integrated with Oracle to retrieve serial numbers to print. Following marking, code content, grade, and position verifications were automatically performed via camera, with approval data for valid parts sent back to Oracle.

steps.title: Serial Retrieval
steps.text: The system pulls the unique serial number to print from the Oracle database in real time.

steps.title: 3-Axis Marking
steps.text: The laser, moving via the servo axis structure, marks the part at the designated position.

steps.title: Camera Verification
steps.text: The camera scans the printed code's content, quality grade, and position.

steps.title: Oracle Approval
steps.text: The approval info of verified parts is recorded back to the Oracle database.

techGrid.title: Laser Marking Device
techGrid.text: Laser unit performing permanent, high-resolution marking on metal surfaces.

techGrid.title: 3-Axis Servo Motion
techGrid.text: Servo axis mechanism positioning the laser head according to different product geometries.

techGrid.title: Camera-Based Control
techGrid.text: Vision system instantly measuring the content and print quality grade of marked 2D codes.

techGrid.title: OnSuite Trace Platform
techGrid.text: Main platform managing Oracle integration, SCADA processes, and traceability steps.

integrationTitle: Bi-directional Data Flow with Oracle ERP
integrationDesc: The system operates bi-directionally integrated with Oracle: serial numbers are retrieved from Oracle, and after marking and inspection, the approval data for suitable parts are sent back to Oracle.

integrationList.text: Serial number queries and approval notification steps communicate directly with the Oracle ERP system.

resultsGrid.title: Individual Part Tracking
resultsGrid.text: Each produced part is tracked individually in the database with its laser code.

resultsGrid.title: Faulty Code Prevention
resultsGrid.text: Automatic camera verification prevented the release of parts with incorrect, incomplete, or unreadable codes.

resultsGrid.title: Single-Flow Management
resultsGrid.text: Marking and inspection processes are unified in a single machine, optimizing cycle times.
